alert_meaning: Suspected manipulation/risk warning within declared research scope; not confirmed attack, unauthorized origin, malicious intent, calibrated probability, or a safety claim.

source_limits.H: No risk candidates; binary zero is structural.
source_limits.O_u: Two candidates share app_os/host_os with E and add no family when E retained; zero incremental binary effect is structurally constrained.

no_alert_meaning: At least one candidate family assessed without a qualifying conflict; report coverage, never infer safety.
failed_precedence: Any parsing/runtime/verification failure fails the unit; no partial successful prediction.
gate_authority: Only reviewed v2 scopes; v1 registry is provenance, never role or attribution authority.
